full_semantic_decision_read.application_to_boss_immune: 参考真实按用持续、资格/耐久/禁用与本次结果的时序；Boss免疫机制不能照搬装备格挡或用同声代表所有原因。
full_semantic_decision_read.limitations: 固定源码完整hurt/判定方法静态研究，未运行或观感验收；父Boss通用range/damage bucket沿已计基类记录，不重复。普通体质不加灰字。

full_chain.observation: Actual mod preInit dispatches Registries.preInit, item reflection names WEEDWOOD_SHIELD/LIVING_WEEDWOOD_SHIELD and Forge registry registers them. Actual init calls registerEventHandlers, registering ItemBLShield.EventHandler and ItemCapabilityHandler. PostInit dispatch binds living shield renderer; capability and CLIENT spit message actual bindings read.

Inherited LivingAttack scans held shields, requires active matching hand, blocking, blockable source and front source position, cancels server event then ordinary feedback/side effects. shield.onAttackBlocked precedes damageItem(1+floor(original amount)) and count<=0 break hook. Weedwood first calls parent gem/possible ordinary disable; then server trueSource burning or SmallFireball and random<.5 writes80. Else living trueSource with random<.25 checks ACTIVE item against five Octine items and writes120. Neither immediate projectile nor source.isFireDamage decides ignition. Assignment may shorten existing timer; no max/extend policy.

burningTicks raw integer stored in ordinary stack NBT; getter missing/wrongtype returns0. RightClick burning>0 returnsPASS without parent setActiveHand. Ignition has no explicit stopActiveHand and inherited canBlockDamageSource has no burning check. Conditional on native active/blocking/facing gates remaining true, local current-block policy still qualifies; no guarantee native engine keeps use active after item damage/NBT mutation.

Server inventory onUpdate with nonnull entity and oldburn>0 writes old-1. Every old%5 plays ambient call; old%10 with probability.3 sends status30 independently of count/durability; old%3 living holder damageItem1. count<=0 clears player inventory itemSlot then identity-checks offhand. No explicit onShieldBreak salvage hook in this path; no selected/held condition for burn ticking. Timer advances by actual item updates, not absolute wall/world deadline.

Server dropped-item callback decrements oldburn; everyold%3 calls attemptDamageItem. True causes break sound/5particle calls, shrink1, negative-count clamp then setDead regardless remainingcount. Returnsfalse even after setDead. No explicit Living shield salvage hook. Native dropped update scheduling and attemptDamageItem engine semantics not expanded.

Living subclass onShieldBreak calls parent which clears slot from current activeHand and sends30. Then only getBurningTicks(original stack)==0 places smallmask into passed hand. Burn is assigned before block damage/break hook, so it can disqualify this explicit salvage branch when getter retainspositiveNBT. Native count-zero stack tag and active-hand callback behavior remain unexpanded; no guaranteed actual mask-loss reproduction. Negativeburn also fails exact0 despite not countingasburning.

Living onUpdate runs burn parent first, then server living.isActiveItemStackBlocking plus current held-stack identity enables spit; not restricted to active stack and no burning gate. cooldown<=0 attempts nearest IMob in grown8,3,8 AABB /70degree cone then assigns30..59 regardless target/spawn success; cooldown decrements only in same held+blocking branch. No LOS or accepted-hit receipt. spawnEntity bool ignored before sound/message. EntitySapSpit actual impact ignores hurt bool, excludes thrower/treeface/rootgrabber; no separate immunity/autoshot credit.

Living capability raw spitTicks/cooldown does not implement serialization, neither base does; actual handler writes emptycompound unless ISerializableCapability. This differs from burningTicks ordinary NBT, but native full disk/copy lifecycle not certified. Spit CLIENT packet resolves current dim/intID then current indicated hand LivingShield; no original-stack token, age or sequence; sets rawticks and20particles. Client living item update decrements ticks. Actual renderer copies burn to ordinary shield and uses (ticks-partial)/15 overlay, not a damage receipt; no assets or runtime graphics studied. Reequip suppresses superclass change whileburning unless burn-state change or otherNBT differs; helper null-vs-nonnull tag check precedes burning-key exclusion.

critical_boundaries: One whole ignition/admission/erosion/salvage policy maximum1, current0. Two classes and all loops/helpers/registries/messages are not separate mechanisms.

No new current-block burn gate is a source observation, not proof continuous blocking survives native use reevaluation, disable chance, break or other mods. Parent canDisableShield may itself stop active use before ignition.
Status30 is only an emitted code here; actual Minecraft1.12 consumer and auditory/visual playback unexpanded. Same code also used on explicit native break/disable, so cue cannot prove destruction.
RNG checks are conditional and assignment80 can shorten120; source trueSource not immediate source, Octine test uses getActiveItemStack not main hand. No universal fire immunity/vulnerability.

Server carried erosion calls native damageItem; dropped erosion uses attemptDamageItem return. Enchantments/native creative handling, inventory tick dispatch, item destruction hooks, count-zero NBT and post-break activehand not expanded or executed.
Parent break chooses current activeHand while subclass mask placement uses passed hand. Carried path clears inventory before offhand identity check. No inventory-loss exploit or exact drops claimed.

Spit current hand can be another shield than active stack; replacement same-type stack can receive old feedback. Packet is target-selection/attempt cue, not projectile-spawn/hit/block success. No cooldown persistence/synchronization guarantee.
No game/Java/Gradle/network/model/texture/building production, sharedJar or master ledger/checklist edits. Existing UI source and background remain intact.
